info.name: Model Failover E2E
info.description: End-to-end tests for the model-failover policy against the gateway IT stack. Generated by generate_collection.py; run with run-e2e.sh.

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Creates the four LlmProviders every scenario uses.

body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: mfe{{run}}-openai-a
spec:
  displayName: mfe{{run}}-openai-a
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /mfe{{run}}-openai-a
  upstream:
    url: http://mock-llm-openai-a:8080
    auth:
      type: api-key
      header: Authorization
      value: Bearer mfe{{run}}-openai-a-key
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: mfe{{run}}-openai-b
spec:
  displayName: mfe{{run}}-openai-b
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /mfe{{run}}-openai-b
  upstream:
    url: http://mock-llm-openai-b:8080
    auth:
      type: api-key
      header: Authorization
      value: Bearer mfe{{run}}-openai-b-key
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: mfe{{run}}-dead
spec:
  displayName: mfe{{run}}-dead
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /mfe{{run}}-dead
  upstream:
    url: http://mock-llm-openai-a:9
    auth:
      type: api-key
      header: Authorization
      value: Bearer mfe{{run}}-dead-key
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: mfe{{run}}-anthropic
spec:
  displayName: mfe{{run}}-anthropic
  version: v1.0
  template: anthropic
  context: /mfe{{run}}-anthropic
  upstream:
    url: http://mock-llm-anthropic:8080
    auth:
      type: api-key
      header: x-api-key
      value: mfe{{run}}-anthropic-key
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

item.name: 01 Ordered failover
item.description: Two OpenAI targets, perAttemptTimeout 2s: every eligible status, non-eligible statuses, reset, timeout, streaming, header hygiene, operations without the policy, body replay.

body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: mfe{{run}}-basic
spec:
  displayName: mfe{{run}}-basic
  version: v1.0
  context: /mfe{{run}}-basic
  provider:
    id: mfe{{run}}-openai-a
  additionalProviders:
    - id: mfe{{run}}-openai-b
